The command to see disk usage of immediate children in human-readable form is typically:
`du -h --max-depth=1`

Or on some systems:
`du -h -d 1`

The "safely previews" might imply using `du -h --max-depth=1 .` to show current directory and its immediate children.

{"result":"du -h --max-depth=1 ."}

I'll output exactly:
{"result":"du -h --max-depth=1 ."}

No markdown, no code blocks. Just raw JSON.
